title: If field choices fail to load, defaults show and the next change saves
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in on the Work Orders build under test with Work Orders view permission; the Board View and Tech View display options are on.
  2. The current location has at least 3 lead technicians shown as groups/columns (a technician is eligible when they are Clockable, Active, and their role is not Office or Time Clock User).
  3. Via New Work Order, create several work orders and set a Lead Technician on each, spread across the technicians with some left Unassigned; then open the Work Orders page.
  4. Ability to force a field-preference load failure.
custom_steps:
1. With the field-preference read forced to fail, open the display.
  2. Confirm it uses the default columns/fields for that display.
  3. Make a new field selection and confirm it saves.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • If field preferences cannot load, the current display uses its List/Tech View default columns or Board View default fields.
  • After a preference-load failure, your next field selection is saved.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10043 (Work Orders — Board View & Tech View Display Options). Story reference: SV-10048 — Choose what is shown (fields and columns). Spec: Confluence page 845185030 “Work Orders — Board View & Tech View Display Options”, PRD v33 (2026-09-28), requirement(s) S5-N2, S5-N3 (read 30 Sep 2026). Review decisions/answers: Confluence page 853901313 where cited. Source-verified on 30 September 2026; not yet build-verified.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S5-N2: “If field preferences cannot load, use Tech View’s starting columns (S5-R4) or Board View’s default fields for the current display.”
  • S5-N3: “Save the user’s next field selection after a preference-load failure.”
